I cannot buy one full bag of chemical fertilizer for such a small piece, but I will get three mudus from the agro-dealer in town like I did last year. I will plant the seed I kept from my last harvest, not those expensive new seeds, and my sons and I will do all the work in about eighteen days. I will not spray chemicals or hire anyone, and there is no water here for irrigation.
